ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; visible ventral surface is approximately 80% high-intensity (white/light grey) and 20% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central region across both lobes. Continuous low-intensity border bands on leading and trailing edges. Left lobe features multiple low-intensity focal points (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity field. Right lobe high-intensity field extends further toward the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 115 degrees; vertex is partially occluded by water spray and low-intensity shadow.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, irregular jagged serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-frequency variations, transitioning to a smoother profile toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe distal margin follows a broad convex curve. Right lobe follows a more acute, elongated sweep tapering to a sharp distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters distributed across the central high-intensity region of the left lobe, ranging from 2-5 pixels in diameter.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and disruption of the geometric contour on the inner trailing margin of the left lobe, immediately adjacent to the median notch.
